name: Nils Ahlberg
description: Neural net. A 46-number role-free copy of jit8 by imitation (1400 steps, 8 DAgger rounds), no reinforcement learning. Elo 1580 (61st of 98) in the old 5v5 ladder of 2026-11-26 (team ratings, before players existed); scored 1.18 and conceded 0.76 per match against the average team.
